reasons: The single insertion supplies every atomic preferred element: professional and workmanlike services, 90-day services documentation conformance, 12-month software/deliverable documentation conformance, malicious-code warranty, compliance with laws, and repair/replace/refund remedies.

The original clause warranted only Y2K date handling, so a concise inserted paragraph is the minimal fix for an otherwise absent performance warranty; the Y2K warranty and the disclaimer sentence remain untouched and effective.

're-performance' is a customer-favourable addition to the required remedy set and does not dilute repair, replacement or refund; no undefined terms or contradictions with the existing disclaimer ('EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT') are introduced.
